items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### Plugin Manager

*   [alex-popov-tech/store.nvim (⭐255)](https://github.com/alex-popov-tech/store.nvim) - A modern plugin discovery and management tool with a database of \~5000 plugins and easy installation via `lazy.nvim`.

### Workflow / Diagnostics

*   [saxon1964/neovim-tips (⭐41)](https://github.com/saxon1964/neovim-tips) - Provides hundreds of built-in Neovim tips, tricks, and shortcuts, with a custom picker interface and the ability to add your own tips.
